description: Explicit discovery projections. Omitted arguments preserve the full legacy catalog.

includeExamples.description: Include validated illustrative requests (default false); examples never authorize their execution.

includeRevisions.description: Include SHA256 revisions of the owning backend catalog and embedded resources (default false).

includeSchema.description: Include complete derived input schemas (default true). False is an explicit projection, not compressed schemas.

names.description: Exact case-sensitive names, in requested order. Omitted/null selects all; [] selects none. At most 64 names.
